::: {#def-broadcasting}

#### Broadcasting

**Broadcasting** is how an elementwise operation such as `+`, `-`, `*` or `/` combines two [tensors](#def-tensor) of different [shapes](#def-shape)
[@goodfellow2016deep, section 2.1].
Line the two shapes up from their last dimension backwards,
and treat a dimension that one [tensor](#def-tensor) lacks at the front as having size 1.
The shapes are compatible when, in every dimension, the two sizes are equal or one of them is 1.
The result takes the larger size in each dimension,
and a tensor with size 1 in a dimension uses its one entry along the whole of it.
When the shapes are not compatible, PyTorch raises an error.
PyTorch's [broadcasting semantics](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/notes/broadcasting.html) page states the same rule,
which PyTorch takes from NumPy.

:::
